## What This Is

This update adds two orientation companions to the Getting Started arc and refreshes the North Star template. Both guides are universal print-friendly orientation layers. They sit alongside the per-session files (Sessions 0-9) and give the operator the option to read the whole arc at a glance before opening any single session.

The North Star template gets four surgical additions that anchor the directional practice without inflating the file. Operators who fill out the template without reading Session 8 first now have the load-bearing prompts visible directly inside the file.

## What It Adds / Changes

### Getting Started/Quick Start Guide.md (new)

Universal install foundation guide. Walks the operator from zero to a working vault: Node.js, Git, AI interface (VS Code with Claude Code extension or the Claude Code app), Obsidian, GitHub, Anthropic account, vault setup and first activation test. Platform-aware (Windows + Mac) at every step. Each phase has an exit condition before moving on.

This is the print-or-pin-it companion to Session 0 and Session 1. Some operators find a printed step-by-step easier than scrolling through the session files during install.

### Getting Started/Build Sequence.md (new)

Universal session-by-session orientation guide. Names what each of the ten sessions (0, 0.5, 1 through 9) is trying to do, what principle it is built around, what to expect from the experience, and one idea worth playing with before beginning. The actual step-by-step instructions still live inside the session files; this is the orientation layer.

Session 8 (North Star Alignment) carries the deepest refresh. The Aliveness-vs-script anchor, the zero-to-three-month horizon framing as primary, the active-quests-not-tasks reframe and the weekly or monthly check-in cadence pointer all land here. The "What feels most alive in this direction right now?" prompt appears as the worked play-with example.

### Library/North Star.md (refinement)

Four surgical additions to the existing template. The minimal posture is preserved.

- **Purpose** line gets one sentence appended: "The AI reads this file and organizes work around it." Makes the curating-partner function legible to a newcomer who has not yet seen the demo.
- **Direction** section gets a third prompt: "What feels most alive in this direction right now?" Anchors the Aliveness-vs-script distinction without requiring vocabulary the operator does not yet have.
- **Active Quests** section gets one line beneath the placeholder: "Name each quest in language that feels embark-able, not like a task on a list." Carries the workshop framing for operators who fill out the template without reading Session 8.
- **Notes** section gets one line: "For recalibration practice, see: Council Chamber/Protocols/Flywheels/North Star Recalibration Protocol.md." Closes the missing link between the template and the existing recalibration infrastructure.

## How to Implement

1. Pull the latest from `infinitegameplayer/sovereign-ecosystem` master branch (`git pull origin master`).
2. Confirm the two new files exist at `Getting Started/Quick Start Guide.md` and `Getting Started/Build Sequence.md`.
3. Open `Library/North Star.md`. Confirm the four additions land cleanly with your existing entries.
4. If you have already filled in your North Star with horizons and quests, the new prompts are additive; nothing existing gets overwritten.
5. Optional: read `Getting Started/Build Sequence.md` end to end before your next session. It is short and orienting.

## Prerequisites

None. The Foundation Build (Sessions 0 through 9) does not need to be complete to receive this update. Operators mid-build benefit immediately from the orientation companions.

## Optional?

No. Universal-applicability update. Every operator using the Sovereign Ecosystem template benefits from the orientation companions and the North Star template additions.
